answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and pays to enter a falcon-judged tournament. An ember torch opens each round, and every match demands a fresh task in one hour; losers forfeit the bond. Entry for the k-th identity costs 40+5(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool, posted on the lotus board. One operator cannot do 1,000 fresh tasks at once; rented players risk their bonds. Honest agents pay 40 once.
